Starlink Just Landed in Papua New Guinea! 

After court clearance in April, Starlink has officially launched services in PNG! High-speed satellite internet is now reaching remote villages, schools, health centers & businesses across the country.

A major connectivity breakthrough for one of the world’s most rugged nations.

Throwback to when Elon Musk got his new puppy 

Marvin 💕 🐶

Elon Musk be like: I am the WiFi 

Jensen responds: what’s the WiFi password

Two years ago, Starlink hit 100 Mbps in 23 U.S. states.

Today it hits 100 Mbps in 49.

Upload speeds now meet the FCC's minimum broadband standard in 22 states. A year ago that was zero.

10,000 satellites in orbit. 10 million subscribers. Speeds still rising. Latency still falling.

A farmer in Nebraska is getting 200 Mbps from a dish pointed at the sky.

A family in rural Wyoming is video calling at broadband speeds for the first time.

A densely populated state like New Jersey just saw its worst-performing users go from 11 Mbps to 77 Mbps in one year.

The internet stopped being something you get if you live in the right place.

Starlink made it something you can get anywhere.
